d: We are seeking an accomplished Senior Legal Advisor – Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) to support complex infrastructure transactions and provide specialist legal advisory expertise.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced legal professional with a strong background in PPP transaction advisory, particularly within major infrastructure and project development environments.
q: Minimum 15 years of professional legal experience.
At least 7 years specialising in PPP transaction advisory.
Qualified lawyer with a strong background in infrastructure and project finance.
Proven experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating PPP agreements.
Strong exposure to complex infrastructure transactions and public-private partnership frameworks.
Experience within an international law firm or specialist infrastructure legal advisory practice is highly desirable.

d: Define and drive the product design strategy aligned with HungerStation’s product and business priorities.
Translate complex customer and business problems into simple, scalable experiences.
Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape product strategy and roadmaps.
Advocate for customer-centric decision-making across the organisation.
Identify experience gaps and opportunities across the end-to-end customer journey.
Own and continuously raise the quality bar across HungerStation’s digital experiences.
Provide design direction and oversight across multiple product domains.
Establish clear design principles, patterns, and standards that create a consistent HungerStation experience.
Lead the evolution and adoption of HungerStation’s design system.
Establish effective design reviews, design QA, and experience-quality processes.
Ensure Design is involved early in discovery and strategic product decisions.
Ensure research, customer feedback, behavioural data, usability testing, and experimentation inform design decisions.
Encourage teams to validate assumptions early and continuously improve experiences after launch.
Partner with Product and Data to measure design impact through conversion, engagement, adoption, retention, customer satisfaction, and usability.
Ensure Design is accountable for measurable customer and business outcomes, not just design output.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Research, Commercial, Marketing, and Operations.
Facilitate alignment around customer problems, priorities, and solutions.
Present design strategy and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
Manage conflicting priorities and influence stakeholders across multiple teams.
Stay engaged through implementation to ensure the intended customer experience is delivered.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Product Designers.
Set clear expectations around ownership, quality, collaboration, and customer impact.
Develop designers’ product thinking, craft, business understanding, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
Support recruitment, performance management, career development, and succession planning.
Build a culture of ownership, constructive feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Contribute to the development and execution of the Division’s ABCs and OKRs, while ensuring alignment with other Functions' heads.
Make critical decisions that support the Division's strategic and tactical direction.
Establish the plans for the respective functions/teams and provide inputs that support the Division’s goals and objectives.
Distribute tactical responsibilities effectively to potential leaders in the Division, to improve the succession readiness of the organization over time.
Measure and track relevant OKRs and metrics to ensure the achievement of goals and take corrective actions when necessary.
Follow all relevant policies, procedures, and processes for the daily work to be carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
Contribute to the identification of opportunities for continuous improvement of processes and practices to enhance effectiveness.
Uphold a high-performance working environment and promote HS’s values.
Set performance objectives, provide necessary support, evaluate direct reports, and provide regular feedback on performance.
Participate in the identification and recruitment of key talents for the function.
Provide clear direction, prioritize tasks, assign and delegate responsibility, and monitor the workflow.
Provide opportunities for team members to suggest, participate in, and contribute to improvement, innovation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Manage and own the budgeting cycle and provide input to the budgeting process.
Ensure effective utilization of the function's budget, and report accurately on progress and challenges.
Investigate and propose implementing strategies that result in a positive financial impact for HS.
Manage the reporting departments effectively within budget, and report accurately on progress made and challenges encountered.
Formulate strategies that result in a positive financial impact for HS and aim to mitigate financial and operational risks.
